summary: Join our Donor Relationship Management Training Course to develop vital skills for nurturing donor relationships and boosting your organization's impact.
lede: Donor relationship management gives fundraising, development, grants, and program professionals a structured way to nurture donor trust and support. The training covers segmenting donors, planning stewardship, communicating results transparently, and tracking interactions and commitments with a CRM or simple tool. Participants also practice responding to donor concerns and changes in scope while keeping relationships mission-aligned.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly engage with donors, funders, and partners. It caters to those who are responsible for nurturing, retaining, and growing donor relationships as part of their role.
audience: Relationship managers in foundations, social enterprises
modules: Designing Donor Journeys and Stewardship Plans
Using CRM and Data to Manage Donor Portfolios
Managing Major Donors and Strategic Partners
Grant Management, Compliance, and Relationship Health
Handling Difficult Conversations and Relationship Risks
Action Planning and Personal Relationship Management Playbook
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of fundraising principles and experience in donor interactions. Prior involvement in managing donor relationships or fundraising campaigns is beneficial.
